text:
Anya: Hey team — quick heads up, I just got pinged, I need to drop the overnight on-call (tomorrow 10pm-6am PST) due to a family emergency. Sorry for the short notice. Can anyone pick up the slot?
Sam: I can take most of it but I have a meeting at 1am PST. Happy to cover 10pm-1am and 2am-6am if someone else can do 1-2am.
Leila: I can do 1-2am. No problem. @Anya hope everything's ok. :heart:
Anya: Thanks @Sam and @Leila, really appreciate it. Quick handoff notes below — small risk: nightly batch might bump memory if a long job runs, watch the queue and cancel if OOM spikes.
Anya: Handoff checklist (quick):
- Check `infra/cron-status` at 23:50 and again at 03:30
- If `batch-job` exceeds 30m, restart via `kubectl rollout restart deployment/batch-worker`
- Alerts: pager channel = #pager, severity thresholds: latency > 5s (page), memory > 80% (page)
- If model-serving node hits GPU-mem > 90% -> failover to `model-variant:small` per runbook

Sam: Copy that. Where's the runbook link?
Anya: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/overnight-inference.md — top section 'failover mapping' is important.
Leila: Noted. Also FYI: last night there was a flakey disk on gpu-node-7, but it cleared after node reboot. Logs: `journalctl -u node-monitor | tail -n 40` showed repeated i/o timeouts. If you see similar we should cordon the node: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7` and open a ticket to infra.
Mike: @Sam @Leila I can be on standby if something escalates (phone on). Probably won't need to wake but ping me on #pager if you page twice in 10m.
Sam: Thanks Mike. One more question — if we need to switch models to lower mem, do we update the policy in Console or just set `model_variant` override in the request-router?
Anya: For overnight emergency we prefer router override so it's faster: POST to `/admin/override` with body `{ "selector": "serve:model-main", "variant": "small" }`. Console change should be done later during business hours.
Sam: Got it. I'll post the override payload in the channel if we need it.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job "nightly-index" will start at 02:05 PST (eta 8m).
Leila: Thanks for the note about `gpu-node-7` — I'll check the node status tonight before 1am.
Anya: Also, policy note: do not escalate to oncall-sre on the first page unless it's a real outage (SLOs broken). Try local mitigation first (restart, failover). Escalate if pages persist > 20m.
Sam: Understood. I'll leave a short handoff message in #eng-oncall-handoff after 10pm with the commands I ran, so morning oncall has context.
Leila: I'll add a sticky note in the ticket if I cordon the node.
Anya: Thanks again — I owe you both. I'll DM any other non-urgent context. :wave:
